title: URL state serialisation preserves sort, filter and page across reload and share
asA: operator sharing a specific datatable view with a colleague
iWant: the sort, filter and page state to serialise into the URL so a reload or a shared link lands on the same view
soThat: the surface is deep-linkable and reload-stable (ADR-1802's recommended default)

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered datatable where the operator applied a sort, a filter and advanced past page 1, the current URL carries the state as query parameters (`sort`, `q`, `page`) per ADR-1802's recommended default; reloading the URL rerenders the same view.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered datatable with an applied sort, filter and non-first page
acceptanceCriteria.then: the reloaded surface renders the same sort, filter and page

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the elicited client-side sort alternative (ADR-1802 elicited variant) applied to a small in-memory collection, the sort direction still writes to the URL so reload stability is preserved; the client-side branch never invents a URL state divergent from the server-side default.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered datatable applying the client-side sort alternative
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator activates a sort control
acceptanceCriteria.then: the URL query parameters update with `sort=<column>:<direction>` in the same shape as the server-side default

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered datatable, the default page size on the recommended default (ADR-1803) applies when no `pageSize` is present in the URL; the operator's elicited page-size override at apply time changes the default without changing the URL contract.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered datatable landed at the shell route without a `pageSize` query parameter
acceptanceCriteria.when: the initial render fetches the first page
acceptanceCriteria.then: the fetch carries `pageSize=<applied-default>` and the URL is left untouched
